stories.title: Core Consent Tier Logic Enforcement
stories.description: Implement business logic enforcing two-tier consent behavior, including Tier 1 (minimal storage) and Tier 2 (expanded storage with explicit consent), with validation gates before any data persistence.

stories.title: Consent API Endpoints and Tool Routing
stories.description: Expose consent capture and retrieval via FastAPI endpoints and integrate with tool_router to ensure all consent-related interactions follow allowlisted tool patterns and validated inputs.

stories.title: Consent Integration with Lead Capture and Unknowns
stories.description: Integrate consent framework with lead capture and unknown question flows to ensure Tier 2 consent is required before storing identifiable data and that fallback flows respect consent state.

stories.title: De-identification and Storage Enforcement Pipeline
stories.description: Implement enforcement pipeline ensuring all data is de-identified under Tier 1 using HIPAA Safe Harbor rules and only stored in identifiable form under Tier 2, with safeguards prior to persistence.
